payload.notes:
First public Windows release of plsDontProc.

- Import your Summoners War JSON and work offline.
- Browse runes, create and edit teams, and search for builds.
- Updated monster stats, leader skills, damage, healing and shield skills.
- Optional automatic update checks, disabled by default.

Download and run `plsDontProc-0.0.1-Setup.exe` on Windows x64. Account data and saved teams stay on your computer.

Support and feedback: https://discord.gg/xUzy8t7Pj
